projectState.summary: Byte 10f-b1 is implemented and ready for review. The manual Ollama health check and thought probe now use the same-origin Vite `/api/ollama/tags` and `/api/ollama/chat` proxy instead of direct browser fetches to Ollama. The proxy forwards only to localhost Ollama targets, keeps prompt construction/parsing/validation/mock fallback in the existing browser-side canonical path, and does not schedule any model output into music.
